mentions.name: Competitive local card game platform
mentions.description: An online platform for a specific card game popular in the author's country, built for competitive play with ELO ratings instead of social features, aiming for lichess.org/chess.com-scale usage and released open source as a portfolio piece.
mentions.problem: Existing online game rooms for the country-specific card game focus on social aspects rather than competitive play with ELO ratings.
mentions.source_excerpt: Local card game: there's a very specific card game played in my country, there's online game rooms, but I want to get something like lichess.org or chess.com scale, oriented towards competitive play, with ELO (instead of social aspects), ideally I would get thousands of users and use it as a portfolio piece while making it open source.
